subject: Conditional settlement window + ‘zipper’ invoice schedule for Q3 ramp
messages:
From: Sophie Keller <sophie.keller@syndicate.health>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Mateo Ruiz <mateo.ruiz@syndicate.health>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement questions — invoicing cadence for pilot

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement has a couple of asks before we execute the PO: we prefer Net60 for pilot vendors while we ramp consumption, and we typically hold 5% retention until the first milestone is accepted. Also, for EU tax reasons, Syndicate wants invoices routed to our Netherlands entity (Syndicate Health BV) and will apply reverse-charge where applicable.

We can share the PO right away (PO# SY-2027-186) if Redwood can accept Net60 + 5% retention for the first two months and a credit cap of $300k while the pilot runs. If you need earlier payment terms in exchange for a discount, let us know a proposal.

— Sophie
Sophie Keller
Head of Procurement, Syndicate Health
sophie.keller@syndicate.health

Attachment: syndicate_PO_SY-2027-186.pdf (attachment stub)

From: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Keller <sophie.keller@syndicate.health>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement questions — invoicing cadence for pilot

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clarity and for the PO number. We want to keep the pilot low-friction while protecting our cash flow during the ramp, so proposing an intermediate approach:

- Conditional Net45 for month 1, moving to Net60 after the second invoice clears on time.
- 3% retention (instead of 5%) for the first two invoices, released after joint acceptance of milestone deliverables.
- Temporary credit corridor capped at $250,000 while the pilot is active (we can revisit at 60 days).
- Invoicing to Syndicate Health BV is fine; we do need an EU VAT certificate or evidence of reverse-charge eligibility before we zero-rate VAT on our invoices.

If Syndicate prefers to keep Net60 outright, we can do that but would request either a 2% prepayment of the first invoice or a 1.5% gross discount across the first 60 days to offset early credit exposure.

I attached a one-page suggested schedule (Redwood_Proposed_Payment_Schedule_v1.pdf) and a VAT evidence request form. Laura from Finance is cc'd for approval — Laura, can we greenlight the temporary $250k corridor and the retention reduction?

Next steps: Sophie, if you can confirm one of the two paths (conditional Net45 or Net60 + discount/prepay) we'll route an amendment and a short DocuSign for signatures.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0139

Attachments: Redwood_Proposed_Payment_Schedule_v1.pdf; VAT_Certificate_Request_Form.docx

From: Sophie Keller <sophie.keller@syndicate.health>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Mateo Ruiz <mateo.ruiz@syndicate.health>, Treasury Team <treasury@syndicate.health>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 08:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement questions — invoicing cadence for pilot

Thanks Jonas — Syndicate prefers to keep Net60 without discounts. Two clarifications:

1) We can accept your conditional Net45 → Net60 path only if the temporary credit cap is raised to $300k (our CFO is comfortable with that for a 45‑day pilot).
2) We will send the VAT registration and tax residency docs for the Netherlands entity but need Redwood to confirm: once we provide the certificate, will Redwood zero-rate VAT and send invoices addressed to Syndicate Health BV with NL VAT number pre-filled?

We can sign the DocuSign amendment if you update the numbers. PO SY-2027-186 is attached again and Treasury will route remits to the NL subsidiary once we have Redwood’s invoice template reflecting the BV company name.

— Sophie

Attachment: syndicate_PO_SY-2027-186.pdf (resend)

From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Keller <sophie.keller@syndicate.health>, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, finance-ops@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement questions — invoicing cadence for pilot

Hi Sophie — Laura from Redwood Finance here. After quick review with ops: we can approve the conditional schedule with the updated cap. Final terms confirmed below for DocuSign amendment: 

- Pilot invoicing: First invoice Net45; subsequent invoices Net60 once the second invoice is paid on schedule.
- Temporary credit cap: $300,000 for 60 days from first invoice date. Review at day 60 for adjustment.
- Retention: 3% holdback on first two invoices, released after milestone acceptance as documented in SOW.
- VAT: Once Syndicate Health BV provides valid VAT/residency documentation and NL VAT ID, Redwood will issue invoices to Syndicate Health BV and apply reverse-charge where allowed. Please send the VAT docs to finance-ops@redwoodinference.com.

I'll upload the short amendment to DocuSign (link will be shared in HubSpot). Expect the DocuSign link within 24 hours; Treasury can sign and then we'll process the PO and schedule the first invoice.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
